status: G02 exports approved and frozen; G03 append-only registration and review in progress
export_notes: Registration is performed offline on a fixed 512x512 canvas. No runtime anatomical stretching or image generation.
Input alpha is genuine transparency. Material normalization treats coverage at or above 240/255 as opaque; lower edge coverage is retained.
Neutral grayscale is derived with Rec.709 luminance. Eyes use deliberately green-coded iris pixels; other materials are not selected by guessed hues.
The neutral mouth is registered at y=354 and precomposited into the face material master, with no new runtime descriptor field.
The G02 runtime matrix is approved by lead review, with no human-recognition claim; G03 expands by new IDs and append-only exports.
The long front hair source is intentionally cropped at the bust boundary during registration; it continues beyond the portrait crop.

components.purpose: Bald oval face base with ears/contour shading; all interchangeable features and mouth absent.
prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a SINGLE production component for a modular 2D fantasy tactical RPG portrait generator, NOT a completed portrait.
Primary request: draw one front-facing adult human BALD FACE MASTER on a true transparent background, in polished clean tactical Japanese RPG portrait style: confident fine tapered ink lines, crisp sculpted cheek and jaw planes, clean two-to-three-tone cel shading, handsome natural anime human proportions rather than a round cartoon avatar. Oval face with a strong but rounded adult jaw. Full head plus ears, no neck, no shoulders.
CRITICAL MODULAR REQUIREMENT: the face has NO eyes, NO eyebrows, and NO nose. The eye/nose area is uninterrupted gently shaded facial skin, like a carefully prepared blank character base onto which separate eye and nose layers will be composited. Do not draw eyelids, eye sockets, empty eye holes, nose bridge, nostrils, or a nose bump. Keep only an understated closed neutral mouth, subtle lower lip and chin shadow. No hair, beard, glasses, clothing, accessories, text, labels, background, or ground shadow.
Composition: square canvas, front-facing symmetric facial geometry, vertically upright, neither tilted nor three-quarter. Use normalized coordinates on a 512x512 rig: skull top centered around (256,64), ear-inclusive head spans x=120 to392, chin ends at (256,408), ears around y=239–290, mouth centered at (256,354). The lower head ends at chin, do not include neck. Leave a large empty transparent margin below y=410 and above y=62. This is a registered FACE component, so do not enlarge it to fill the entire canvas. Preserve these relative proportions at whatever output resolution is used.
Colors: strictly neutral GRAYSCALE material master, no skin hue or colored pixels. Skin midtone around 65% gray with pale highlights and restrained 35% gray shadow planes; dark fine ink for outer contour and mouth. Smooth clean cel shading, no painterly skin texture, no speckles, no gradients that flatten form. Upper-left lighting. Jaw and ears must be fully rendered and isolated. Actual transparent alpha outside the head. No checkerboard painted into pixels.
Quality priority: expressive designed head anatomy and refined linework suitable for a premium tactical RPG, with clear silhouette at small thumbnails. This is deliberately a featureless eye/nose base, not a finished character.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: modular fantasy tactical RPG grayscale FACE MASTER. Among the recent images, the BALD FEATURELESS GRAYSCALE HEAD ON TRANSPARENT ALPHA is the exact edit target. The FOUR COLORED ANIME PORTRAITS sheet is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, showing the desired cleaner anime treatment.
Make ONE targeted anatomy correction to the grayscale head: MOVE THE CLOSED MOUTH AND ITS LOWER-LIP SHADING DOWN by about 50 pixels on this 1254x1254 canvas (4% of the canvas height). The mouth line currently around y=770 should be around y=820. Fill its old location seamlessly with the existing grayscale skin. Move the complete lips as one unit, keeping their current width and neutral expression. This shortens the distance between mouth and chin. Keep the chin tip exactly where it currently is, around y=950; do not move or lengthen the jaw.
Preserve the head silhouette, skull top, ears, cheek planes, lighting, canvas size, transparency, and location of all other pixels as closely as possible. Keep the eye and nose region completely blank: NO eyes, eyebrows, eyelids, nose, nose shadow, nostrils or hair. No neck or shoulders. No text. Strictly neutral grayscale. Keep genuine transparent alpha outside the head, never paint a checkerboard.
Style should remain clean confident anime RPG ink with sculpted cel-shaded planes, consistent with the colored style sheet but still an unfinished grayscale modular base. The only substantive change is lowering the mouth and lip shading.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the LAST IMAGE: the transparent grayscale bald head master with completely blank eye/nose area. Move ONLY the entire mouth and lower-lip shading DOWN ANOTHER 24 PIXELS (about 2% of canvas height), leaving the head outline and chin exactly fixed. The dark mouth line currently sits at y=816 on the 1254x1254 canvas; it MUST sit at y=840 after this edit. Repaint the old mouth location smoothly with existing neutral gray skin. Keep mouth width and neutral expression. Do not move chin (y=973), skull top (y=127), ears or cheek shading. Keep every other feature in place. Preserve true transparent alpha, same canvas and framing, strictly neutral grayscale. No eyes, brows, nose, nostrils, hair, neck or shoulders. Crisp clean anime cel illustration. This is a precise alignment correction for modular production: lower the lips by the requested distance, not the entire head.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the last grayscale bald head component: REMOVE the mouth, lips, lip shadow and lip highlights entirely, replacing that small region with seamless neutral-gray facial skin shading. Preserve the head silhouette, ears, jaw, chin, skull top, cheek planes, grayscale lighting, framing and transparent background exactly. Do not move any part of the head. The result is a completely featureless FRONT-FACING HEAD BASE with ears and facial contour/shading but NO mouth, NO lips, NO eyes, NO brows, NO nose and NO hair. This is intentional: separate modular facial features will be positioned precisely in an export pipeline. Keep refined clean anime RPG linework and restrained clean cel shading. No neck, shoulders, text or symbols. Preserve genuine alpha transparency outside the head.

components.purpose: Eye/brow assembly; green channel marks iris pigment for separate source/mask export.
components.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE modular eye-and-brow assembly for a clean anime tactical fantasy RPG portrait. Draw a matched PAIR of expressive open human eyes and their eyebrows, isolated on genuine transparent alpha with no face or surrounding skin patch. Refined confident Japanese RPG character linework, sharp upper eyelids, restrained tapered lashes, slightly angular natural eyebrows, alert calm expression. Both eyes front-facing and level, natural adult anime proportions, not huge chibi eyes. Eye pair centered, occupying about two thirds of a wide canvas, brows just above eyes. Transparent gap between the eyes wide enough for a separate nose. No nose, mouth, head outline, ears, hair, labels or border.
PRODUCTION MASK CODING: ALL linework, brows, pupils, shadows and eye whites must be neutral grayscale. Fill ONLY the colored iris rings with vivid PURE GREEN (RGB 0,255,0) as a deliberate technical material marker; keep black pupils and small white specular highlights on top. This green is not a final eye color. Absolutely no green anywhere outside the irises. Each iris must be neatly enclosed inside its eye, with the round black pupil visible. Clean off-white sclera, crisp dark gray upper lids, lighter lower lids. No surrounding skin color or pink tear ducts. True transparent alpha around every eye/brow shape, no painted checkerboard. This single assembly will be registered, split by its explicit green material channel and recolored in an offline export pipeline.
